office_does: District Court judges hear misdemeanor and gross misdemeanor criminal cases, traffic infractions, civil suits up to $100,000, small claims, protection orders and felony first appearances for Clark County.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Leslie A. Lopez is the only candidate for Department 4, on the ballot for both the short and the full four-year term.

candidates.summary: District Court judge since 2025, after serving as court commissioner and chief civil deputy prosecutor; on the ballot for the short and full four-year term. The only candidate.
highlights: Chief Civil Deputy in the Clark County Prosecutor's Office 2021-2024 [S1]
On the ballot for both the short and the full four-year term [S2]
